goal: must prevent senti upgrade from generating unused project-local .senti/templates/<lang>/docs/creating_presets.md files while preserving base preset guardrail managed-copy syncing.

analysis.problem: Issue #401 reports that deployPresetCopies() unconditionally writes .senti/templates/<lang>/docs/creating_presets.md for each configured language. The base preset chapters do not include creating_presets.md, so preset validation treats the generated project-local template as an extra unlisted chapter and emits a creating_presets.md not listed in chapters warning after upgrade. Migration parity inventory: retained public surfaces are standard senti upgrade preset-copy side effects for .senti/presets/base/guardrail.json and .senti/presets/base/guardrail-rewrite-rubric.md; removed public side effect is automatic creation or update of .senti/templates/<lang>/docs/creating_presets.md.
analysis.proposedApproach: Remove project-local creating_presets.md generation from deployPresetCopies(), keep .senti/presets/base/guardrail.json and .senti/presets/base/guardrail-rewrite-rubric.md synced as managed base preset copies, and cover the generation target contract with regression tests. Migration parity mapping: retained managed preset copies remain owned by deployPresetCopies(); removed project-local creating_presets.md generation has no replacement owner because existing files are user-owned and upgrade must not manage them.
analysis.validation: The approach addresses the root problem because the warning is caused by creating a project-local template that is outside the effective chapter list. Existing docs/preset validation behavior remains unchanged; the generated target set is corrected instead. Migration parity verification must prove deployPresetCopies() returns and writes only the retained base preset managed-copy paths, does not create new project-local creating_presets.md paths for configured languages, and leaves an existing project-local creating_presets.md file byte-for-byte unchanged.
